stories.title: France's wealthiest citizens cut their income tax bill in 2025
stories.summary: Income tax revenues increased by 1% in 2025. But for the wealthiest 0.1% of taxpayers, who are better able to manage their resources and their declared amounts, the average tax paid actually fell by 9%, according to a study by the Finance Ministry.
